description: Compute key price levels for a ticker: support/resistance zones (clustered swing highs/lows with touch counts = how often price reacted there), nearby round numbers, 50/200-day moving averages, and the 52-week high/low. Returns nearest levels above (resistance) and below (support) with distance %. Use these for concrete trigger/target/invalidation levels.
name: get_key_levels
title: Key price levels
